Tenant.delegates: exactly one TenantRuntime; instance API, :: in design tables denotes responsibility, not static global state

TenantRuntime.replacement: host explicit replacement or decorator to one delegate; same token/LIFO/cleanup/poison corpus, never an additional frame stack

ContextResolver.semantics: every enter including same identity/single, and previous-frame restore; durable selection carries expected binding; fresh host routing, availability and authorized origin. Does not return cached permission verdict.

Facility.semantics: journal/state recorded before prepare; prepare snapshots and does no external mutations; activate changes facility; restore compensates partial activation idempotently; verify observes restored state. All started restore attempts run even if previous lookup or another cleanup fails.

CompositionBuilder.semantics: host SPI bindings and profiles constructor-configured; compile performs version/slot/replacement/dependency checks before resolver/prepare/IO, freezes builder; any later register/rebind/compile fails composition_frozen

ContextCodec.semantics: strict JSON/UTF-8/schema/byte/depth checks first; no lookup or activation; host registry validation still mandatory. Duplicate JSON keys rejected before decoder overwrites them.

ExtensionDecoder.semantics: registered exact type/version/handler, after resource activation and before current publication; may only read candidate facets, no effects. Product mutation admission rechecked by owning handler.

BindingVerifier.semantics: public resource-owner port; sole protocol tenant.binding/1; same semantic algorithm/corpus for CoreX checkpoint and tenant-postgres, with owner-specific persistence adapter. No catalog access by Laravel sibling.

ObservationSink.kind: Spi interface, zero or more independently registered sinks
ObservationSink.semantics: runtime iterates every observer, catches each Throwable and diagnostic failure; non-veto/no tenant effect; reentry guard active; no dispatcher required

DiagnosticSink.semantics: best-effort, exceptions swallowed without recursive diagnostics or state change

ContextDispatcher.semantics: job is framework-local and must have scalar payload; no class-string in Tenant envelope. freeze validates explicit target; enqueue freshly verifies same frozen target, never recaptures ambient. Sync uses nested run. No default ambient dispatch.

PostgresLifecycle.kind: Spi optional owner interface; types in Tenant\Postgres, not kernel
PostgresLifecycle.semantics: no actor authority on wire; Admission is fresh trusted host callback/capability, not a serialized grant; commands/receipts/FSM owned wholly by optional package; automatic restore/clone unsupported v1, controlled operator runbook only

algorithm: collect immutable declarations; validate unique namespaced IDs and SPI versions

resolve explicit replacements by exact existing target before graph: one replacer per target, same stage/slots and provides superset; reject chains/ambiguous replacements; rewrite edges naming replaced target to replacement
decorators wrap exactly one explicitly named delegate; no additional slot claim/stack; decorator dependency/order also acyclic
reject duplicate exclusive slots and missing required capabilities/dependency IDs; no priority/registration-order winner
build requires-provider/before/after edges; ambiguous capability provider requires explicit host selection, not arbitrary first match
resource stage precedes product stage; reject any edge that forces product before required resource
stable Kahn topological order with ready IDs sorted by ASCII bytes; cycles rejected
freeze profile/SPI bindings, factories and graph before first resolve/IO; every binding replacement before compile; all late mutation fails
composition.lifetime: each factory creates participant per frame; runtime creates separate FrameState per participant before prepare. Never reuse singleton saved-original state. Manifest/factories reusable; mutable states and proofs not reusable.
composition.hostReplacement: public resolver/facility/codec/verifier/runtime SPI only, same version/profile/capabilities and corpus. Full runtime replacement removes default binding; facade/provider share it. No runtime/resolver constructor cycle from participants.
composition.registrationReentry: register rejected after freeze even inside observations; enter/restore in participant/observer transition rejected before mutation; application callback can nest after transition.
composition.hostServices: Selected resolver/codec/verifier/runtime service bindings declare exact SPI version, implementation ID, slot and capabilities before compile; service capabilities satisfy requirements. Only participant-provider edges enter resource/product graph; service construction has no dependency back to runtime or tenant IO.

fresh resolve+expected binding and origin/purpose checks, same-ID included
save baseline and create frame-local participant state, append started before prepare
resource prepare/activate, public binding verifier before tenant IO; candidate-only reads
product decoder/relation hooks, then publish Active/Central + new generation atomically
entered success observation with protected observer iteration
application callback; nested run allowed; handler fresh admission/effect belongs to host

publish verified previous state with new generation and restored observation, invalidate old handles permanently
if callback failed rethrow it after successful cleanup; if cleanup failed throw RestoreFailed with original+all cleanup causes and poison; no success result
runtimeProtocol.failure: unresolved/denied enter causes no resource change; partial failure restores every started participant including failing one; failed previous lookup still performs available cleanup and poisons; invalid foreign/out-of-order/consumed token refuses without popping valid top. No force-central success.
runtimeProtocol.transitions: current throws transition_in_progress during prepare/activate/restore; Missing|Central|Active are the only public states. restore verification of maintenance resource is distinct from ordinary effect admission.
runtimeProtocol.generations: scope instances invalidated for every switch/restore, same-resource nesting included; retained A handle invalid after B and after returning to A; re-resolve new A service.
runtimeProtocol.poison: guard prevents further IO even within callback catching failure; worker stops before next job; FPM first profile requires pm.max_requests=1; token/stream boundary leak is fatal, destructor not safety proof.
runtimeProtocol.observationOrder: entered/restored only after successful state+generation publication; failed activation emits activation_failed not entered; callback_failed separate; restore_failed then poisoned on fatal cleanup. Every observer gets immutable subject, no ambient lookup; exceptions do not alter transition/callback outcome; diagnostics exceptions do not mask causes.
runtimeProtocol.lane: one sequential lane, no Fibers/global-facility interleaving; concurrent enter is concurrent_entry refusal
runtimeProtocol.central: Central profile activates deny-default tenant bindings and fixed explicit named control access; no tenant identity/marker lookup. Missing baseline remains Missing after nested run. Central resolution validates trusted explicit intent and profile without synthesizing tenant identity.
runtimeProtocol.openLease: Direct restore with outstanding tracked lease refuses open_resource before mutation; caller can close then retry. run detects leaked leases/tokens on callback completion and raises fatal frame_leak, suppresses result and poisons/quarantines rather than claiming successful restore.

wireValidation.central: no identity/resource fields (including explicit null); no extensions. Central dispatch creates clean explicit named-control frame, never inherits tenant stamp. Missing envelope rejects unless known central job/producer explicitly allowlisted.
wireValidation.single: all tenant identity/resource fields mandatory, even synthetic no-IO host; single != null/central. Exact one boot configured identity.
wireValidation.route: durable routeRevision mismatch refuses stale_route; logical fresh selection may use new authoritative route. Never retarget durable ref automatically; maintenance/recovery emits explicit new reference.
wireValidation.extensions: refs map scalar strings only; no nested objects, credentials/authority/class names. Semantic decoder allows exact field names only for each type; unknown required fails before activation, unknown optional ignored with no effects. Type/version may be referenced but implementation never chosen by payload.
wireValidation.encoding: UTF8 JSON, no duplicate keys/NaN/Infinity. Canonical bytes for hashes are recursively key-sorted compact UTF8 JSON without ASCII escaping; arrays preserve order, extensions sorted by type and unique. Kernel reference contains no floats.

ScanWorkReconciler prepares vaulter.drive:scan with scalar obligation/generation/driveId/claimedTenant BEFORE registering afterCommit; publish immediate/reconciler path also requires verified explicit target
PurgeDriveJob continuation passes received original PublicationContext into prepare; bridge validates it and keeps exact mode/ref/incarnation/extensions, never captures a different current target
publish freshly checks frozen target availability/incarnation and purpose through host policy; may publish A from B context without changing target, or refuse; never replace A with B

consumer pre-hydration host restoration then Vaulter fresh owner/current/claimed tenant validator then actor/admission and effect; real A/B same driveId IO/scan/purge/continuation tests required in P5.2
unique locks partition by original resourceRef/incarnation+task+scalar operation refs; central lock store does not imply central execution; no driveId-only cross-resource suppression
vaulterSeam.defaultNeutral: when tenancy disabled, Vaulter default publisher may use framework dispatcher without Tenant. With bridge enabled+strict, Missing/Central capture refuses missing/denied, never silent untagged fallback. No guaranteed hook based only on ambient Laravel payload callback.

scalarProjection.format: t1. + unpadded base64url(uint8(namespace UTF8 byte length) || namespace UTF8 bytes || normalized id UTF8 bytes)
scalarProjection.rule: Both current() and tenantOf(fresh owner mapping) use the identical injective function. General Tenant namespace<=48 ASCII bytes/id<=96 UTF8 bytes; this bridge requires namespace<=32 and combined namespace+id<=44 UTF8 bytes. UUID36 permits namespace<=8. No trim/hash/int-string coercion/fallback. Out-of-profile input refuses identity_encoding_unsupported before writing. Boot requires host_keys=string and fresh actual tenant columns >=64; bigint/uuid/ulid host-key modes refuse this profile. Single is nonempty; incarnation verified separately, not part of business scalar.
scalarProjection.source: Vaulter packages/core/src/Schema/VaulterSchema.php::tenant -> HostKeyColumns::add string(64); KernelSchema idempotency tenant_id string(191). Actual configured/fresh installed columns must be verified by P5.2, runtime/install evidence still not-run.

optionalLifecycleTypes.OperationKey: namespace + nonempty opaque command key; never recycled across tombstones/replay horizon
optionalLifecycleTypes.ProvisionIntent: schemaVersion=1, operationKind=provision, hostIntentRef, frozen clusterBinding, templateRef/version/manifestHash, canonical parameters; original allocation stored before physical effect
optionalLifecycleTypes.ExportIntent: schemaVersion=1, operationKind=export, resourceRef/incarnation, archive destination ref and retention profile ref; no credentials
optionalLifecycleTypes.DeleteIntent: schemaVersion=1, operationKind=delete, resourceRef/incarnation, verified original exportRef if retention profile requires, policy intent ref
optionalLifecycleTypes.RecoveryIntent: schemaVersion=1, operationKind=restore|clone, original archiveRef/hash/resource/incarnation, target frozen binding and privileged host purpose; no automatic execution v1
optionalLifecycleTypes.Admission: fresh trusted host authorization capability/callback bound to purpose and exact target, nonserializable; repeat before effects/replay/query visibility
optionalLifecycleTypes.OperationRef: namespace + original operationId + resourceRef/incarnation; no redirect to newer operation
optionalLifecycleTypes.ExportRef: original exportId + operationRef; not latest export timestamp
optionalLifecycleTypes.OperationReceipt: original operationId/key/intentDigest, resourceRef/incarnation, attemptGeneration, status accepted|running|unknown|succeeded|failed|cancelled, observedEffect, original exportRef/result if any, receiptVersion; safe refs only
optionalLifecycleTypes.ExportReceipt: original exportId/operationId + archive manifest/hash/destinationRef + state; no signed URLs/secrets in durable record exposed by Tenant
optionalLifecycleTypes.RecoveryPlan: operator-only verified steps, external anchor generation, quarantine/admission requirements; not an authorization or completed restore receipt
optionalLifecycleTypes.idempotency: canonical intent compact sorted UTF8 JSON over all semantic fields; SHA256 includes cluster/template and stable original target, excludes fresh actor/admission/attempt/time. Same key different digest conflicts even after deletion. Repeated same key returns original receipt after fresh admission; unknown outcome query/reconcile same operation.
optionalLifecycleTypes.physicalProtocol: claim metadata + freeze target/attempt -> same-session advisory lock and DDL outside metadata Tx -> observe exact marker/catalog -> CAS attempt/incarnation -> durable receipt/outbox -> publish. No second host SQL; lock loss/timeout unknown, quarantine until old backend excluded; cancellation not undo of submitted DDL.
